lines: The "personality" of the Technocyte Coda is chosen from one of the On-lyne members: Harddrive, Zeke, Drillbit, Packet, or DJ RoM.

- Arthur: "Okay. Aoi says: "Tell the Drifter they are now being hunted by On-lyne, only it's not them, it's the Techrot, it stole their shapes, oh sweet Lua, this is horrible. Emoticon. Emoticon. Emoticon.""
- Arthur: "Techrot's awake. Hungry. Taking on a new form. I think it's trying to become.... the, uh... On-lyne boys..?"
- Arthur: "It turns out Aoi's conspiracy theories were true: On-lyne really have been cloned and used to create Techrot parodies. I'm sorry to say you just attracted their attention."
- Arthur: "Drifter, new Techrot Coda just hatched. Tracking your Void-saturated DNA signature. Has an expiry date of... never. You might be stuck with this one for a while."
- Arthur: "If Amir's take on the situation is accurate you are now being stalked by a knockoff clone of a popular late twentieth century boyband. If you need backup, you know where to find us."

- Arthur: "Viruses are dangerous, Techrot viruses are lethal. The one you just created has based itself on On-lyne for reasons I can't even pretend to fathom. But I doubt mimicking a boyband will make it any less of a headache."
> In the process of your pressing eject on [ADVERSARY NAME], Ordis recovered the following. Maybe Eleanor would be interested to see the Live Heartcells? Ordis remains YOUR biggest fan.
> What a show! What do you say to MERGING OUR FECUND CELLS and forming a Supergroup? I bet we could really EVISCERATE the charts!
> I've already got some new track ideas to ACHIEVE TOTAL SYSTEM DOMINANCE!
